- Preferred payment method: bank transfer (SEPA) — please provide wiring instructions and the invoice remittance reference format so our finance team can match the payment.

Attached: GridScale_PO_2026.pdf (PO stub).

Can you confirm timelines and any documentation we should return (signed SOW/DocuSign) to trigger invoicing?
